articles.title: Two Big Leaders Make a Deal About AI and Trade
articles.summary: The leaders of the U.S. and China met for three days in Washington. They agreed to set up a special hotline for AI problems and keep talking about trade. Trump said the U.S. is still ahead in AI.

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV Draws 700,000 People to Paris Mass
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated an open-air Mass in Paris with an estimated 700,000 people. He praised young people's 'energy and commitment' and rode down the Champs-Élysées in his popemobile.

articles.title: Supreme Court Allows Citizenship Check System Again
articles.summary: The Supreme Court let the government restart a data system that checks if voters are U.S. citizens. The system has mistakenly flagged some eligible voters. The case is still going.
